user_story: As a user, I want to access HTTP status code pages so that I can understand the different responses returned by a web server. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When I visit the page at https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/status_codes, I should see the heading 'Status Codes'. 2. I should be able to click on the link '200' and be redirected to the URL https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/status_codes/200. 3. If I click on the link '404', I should be redirected to the URL https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/status_codes/404.
